problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 7 delivery trucks to transport packages through 7 distribution hubs.

Each package follows a predetermined route through the hubs, represented as pairs (Hub, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the hub where the package must be processed and the time required for handling.
The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which hubs must be visited.

Package details:
* P1 follows the route: (H6, 4) → (H2, 8) → (H1, 3) → (H5, 10) → (H3, 9) → (H4, 5) → (H7, 1)
* P2 follows the route: (H5, 3) → (H2, 1) → (H3, 8) → (H7, 4) → (H6, 10) → (H4, 7) → (H1, 6)
* P3 follows the route: (H4, 6) → (H3, 10) → (H7, 7) → (H2, 7) → (H5, 10) → (H6, 7) → (H1, 9)
* P4 follows the route: (H3, 5) → (H6, 9) → (H5, 3) → (H2, 9) → (H1, 3) → (H4, 10) → (H7, 9)
* P5 follows the route: (H7, 5) → (H5, 8) → (H6, 9) → (H4, 1) → (H2, 4) → (H3, 5) → (H1, 8)
* P6 follows the route: (H6, 1) → (H1, 4) → (H7, 3) → (H2, 10) → (H3, 3) → (H5, 6) → (H4, 10)
* P7 follows the route: (H7, 4) → (H3, 7) → (H1, 8) → (H5, 6) → (H4, 6) → (H6, 2) → (H2, 10)

Each package must be processed continuously at each hub without interruption once handling begins,
and each distribution hub can only handle one package at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all packages at the hubs
so that the total completion time for all deliveries is minimized.
